taxonomy_definitions.VERIFIED_PRIMARY_SOURCE: Directly confirmed against authentic textbook content AND matching active competitive examination syllabi across all assigned exams.
taxonomy_definitions.VERIFIED_TEXTBOOK_ONLY: Present in official NCERT textbook, but excluded from all active competitive examination syllabi.
taxonomy_definitions.PARTIAL_MAPPING: Present in textbook and included in some exams (e.g. JEE Advanced), but excluded from others (e.g. JEE Main or NEET UG).
taxonomy_definitions.NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: Discrepancy or gap between official syllabus and textbook (e.g. extra plant families in NEET, frog vs cockroach in biology).
taxonomy_definitions.EXCLUDED_BY_SYLLABUS: Topic formally removed during the 2024 national rationalization exercise.
taxonomy_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Section numbering or exam mapping assigned formulaically without primary line-item audit.
